lobby.subtitle: Jump into a voice room or start your own
lobby.nothingFoundHint: Try a shorter query, or create a room with that name yourself.

roomsError.title: Could not load rooms
roomsError.description: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No rooms yet
empty.text: Rooms show up here the moment someone creates one. Start the first one and share the link — whoever opens it lands straight in the call.

room.notFoundHint: The owner deleted this room, or the link is out of date. Check the link or find the room in the lobby.

invite.aloneDescription: Send the link and friends join in one click.

music.label: Room music
music.title: Music in the room
music.description: Play tracks for everyone in the room, or share your own music.

link.label: Add a link
link.placeholder: Paste a YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo or audio file link

nowPlaying.stop: Turn off the music for everyone

empty.title: It's quiet here
empty.description: Paste a link or turn on the radio.

radio.label: Stations
radio.error: Radio search is unavailable right now.

share.title: My music
share.hint: Music plays from your account — VK Music, Yandex Music or anything else open in a browser tab — and everyone in the room hears it.
share.tabHint: In the picker, choose the tab with the music and turn on “Share tab audio”.
share.tabUnsupported: Sharing a tab's audio needs a desktop browser.
share.filesHint: Pick audio files — they play for everyone in the room straight from your device.
share.noAudio: No audio was shared — turn on “Share tab audio” in the picker.
share.publishFailed: Couldn't start sharing in this room.

player.networkHint: Everyone else keeps listening. Turn on a VPN and try again, or pick radio or SoundCloud.
player.restrictedTitle: This video won’t play for you
player.restrictedHint: Its owner limited embedding, or it isn’t available in your region. Everyone else keeps listening.
player.failedTitle: This track won’t play for you
player.failedHint: Everyone else keeps listening. Try again or move on to the next track.
player.removed: This video was removed or made private — skipping it.
player.blockedTitle: The browser held back the sound
player.blockedHint: Press Listen and the music picks up where the room is.

tabOnly.title: {service} can't be embedded
tabOnly.hint: Play it in a browser tab and share that tab's audio from My music — everyone in the room will hear it.

volume.label: Music volume
volume.hint: Only for you — others keep their own level.

password.heading: This room is locked
password.hint: Ask whoever sent you the link for the password — “{name}” will not open without it.
password.label: Password

shortcuts.pttBlockedByMute: Microphone is muted — unmute to use push-to-talk

screen.sharingHint: Your own preview is hidden so the screen doesn't repeat inside itself. Everyone else sees it.

room.dmWaiting: Waiting for the other person to join…
room.invisibleNotice: You joined hidden: nobody sees or hears you

invisible.blockedHint: Microphone, camera, screen, reactions, chat and music are off so nobody notices you. Turn invisible mode off to take part.
invisible.noticeHint: Microphone, camera, reactions and chat stay off until you turn invisible mode off.
invisible.chatReadOnlyHint: A message would reveal that you're here.
invisible.passwordHint: You joined “{name}” invisibly, without the password. To appear in it, enter the password — or stay invisible.

callService.text: You're in a voice room. Tap to return.

chat.title: Chat
chat.editHint: Enter to save · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to cancel
chat.deleteDescription: This message will be permanently removed for everyone. This action cannot be undone.

empty.title: It's quiet here
empty.description: Messages sent in this room appear here and stay for everyone who joins later. Drop a link, a file or just say hi.

channels.nothingFoundHint: No room matches that name. Clear the search to see all of them again.
channels.emptyHint: Pick a room from the page, or start a new one.

activity.heading: Friend activity
activity.available: {count, plural, one {# free to talk} other {# free to talk}}
activity.others: {count, plural, one {+# more person} other {+# more people}}
activity.emptyHint: None of your friends are around. Start a room and be the first one in.

createRoom.title: Create a room
createRoom.description: Set a name, pick who can join, and we drop you straight into the call.
createRoom.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. Share it only with people you want inside.
createRoom.privateExplainer: The room stays listed under a lock. Only people with the password can get in.
createRoom.publicExplainer: Everyone sees the room in the lobby and can join without a password.
createRoom.hint: You can rename the room or change its password later from the room menu.

edit.title: Edit room
edit.description: Rename the room, or switch it between public and private.
edit.passwordHint: Leave empty to keep the current password.
edit.privateExplainer: The room stays listed under a lock. Only people with the password can get in.
edit.publicExplainer: Everyone sees the room in the lobby and can join without a password.
edit.hint: Changing the password does not kick anyone out — it only affects new joins.

delete.title: Delete "{name}"?
delete.description: Anyone currently inside will be disconnected. This cannot be undone.
delete.consequences: The room, its chat history, and every channel inside it are gone for good.
delete.hint: Everyone currently in the call will be disconnected right away.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the room?
remove.description: {name} is disconnected right away and sent back to the lobby. They can join again.

ban.title: Ban {name} from the room?
ban.description: {name} is disconnected right away and can't rejoin until you lift the ban in the room menu.

notices.removed: You were removed from the room
notices.banned: You were banned from the room
notices.muted: The room owner muted your microphone
notices.unmuted: The room owner let you speak again

bans.title: Banned users
bans.description: People banned from "{name}" can't join it until you lift the ban.
bans.empty: Nobody is banned from this room.
